uncited: *   **Input:** Ray origin $\mathbf{o}$, normalized direction $\mathbf{d}$, base step size $\Delta t_{\text{base}}$, initial mip level $m_{\text{base}}$, empty threshold $N_{\text{empty}}$, maximum distance $t_{\text{max}}$, maximum iterations $N_{\text{max}}$, and a scene function $V(\mathbf{p}, m)$ returning density and opacity.
Evaluate density $d$ and opacity $\alpha$ at $\mathbf{p} = \mathbf{o} + t\mathbf{d}$ using $V(\mathbf{p}, m)$.
If `consecutive_empty` $\ge N_{\text{empty}}$, double the step size ($\Delta t \leftarrow 2 \cdot \Delta t$) and increase the mip level ($m \leftarrow m + 1$), then reset `consecutive_empty` to 0.

If $d \ge \epsilon$ (non-empty): step back one step ($t \leftarrow t - \Delta t$), restore the step size ($\Delta t \leftarrow \Delta t_{\text{base}}$) and mip level ($m \leftarrow m_{\text{base}}$), reset `consecutive_empty` to 0, advance the ray ($t \leftarrow t + \Delta t$), and update accumulated opacity $\alpha_{\text{acc}} \leftarrow \alpha_{\text{acc}} + \alpha(1 - \alpha_{\text{acc}})$.
Repeat until $t \ge t_{\text{max}}$, $\alpha_{\text{acc}} \ge 1 - \epsilon$, or the iteration count reaches $N_{\text{max}}$.
